R3_algorithm_boundary_no_canonicalizatio.role: semantic boundary known, byte representation absent

R8_wrong_canonicalization.role: complete but wrong canonical byte representation

metadata_drift_result.finding: stored integrity metadata does not govern current verifier execution

next_smallest_pressure_frontier: test a minimal non-persistent declarative commitment-semantics record against the same recovery chart

outcome_semantics.MISMATCHED: the supplied regime can execute comparison and finds incompatible commitments or extent
outcome_semantics.RECOVERED: the supplied regime can evaluate the H14 prefix and finds it conserved
outcome_semantics.UNRESOLVED: the supplied regime lacks information needed to justify recovered or mismatched

prior_history_source_classification: Git analytical comparison evidence, not runtime witness authority
strongest_unresolved_horizon: minimum declarative commitment semantics worth conserving before any witness persistence boundary is selected
verifier_implementation_finding: bounded semantics are sufficient for this pressure; no persistent verifier specification was introduced
